meta.title: Teammate Model Picker
meta.description: Lets you manually pick the model for a teammate (subagent): when it's stuck on a model it can't use (say, out of quota), switch it to one that works and let it carry on — no rebuilding, and your own conversation and the global default model are untouched.

picker.label: This teammate’s model
picker.hint: Changes only this teammate’s model; your own conversation and the global default model are untouched
picker.clear: Go back to its original model
